def date_to_doy(date):
    """Convert date to day of year (1-366)"""
    # Handle leap year cases
    if date.month == 2 and date.day == 29:
        return 60  # February 29th maps to day 60
    
    # Create a date object for Jan 1 of the same year
    jan1 = datetime(date.year, 1, 1)
    # Calculate the difference in days

    # Adjust for leap year special case

        if doy > 59:  # Days after Feb 28

    return doy

def smooth_366(arr):
    """Apply 31-day centered moving average to 366-element array"""
    smoothed = np.zeros_like(arr, dtype=np.float64)
    half_window = 15
    
    for i in range(366):
        # Calculate the window boundaries
        window_start = max(0, i - half_window)
        window_end = min(366, i + half_window + 1)
        
        # Handle wrapping around the year
        if window_start == 0:
            # Include values from the end of the year
            if i + half_window >= 366:
                # Need to wrap around
                wrapped_values = arr[window_start:window_end]
                wrapped_values = np.concatenate([arr[366-(half_window-i):366], arr[0:window_end]])
            else:
                wrapped_values = arr[window_start:window_end]
        elif window_end == 366:
            # Include values from the beginning of the year
            wrapped_values = arr[window_start:window_end]
            wrapped_values = np.concatenate([arr[window_start:], arr[0:half_window-(366-window_start)]])
        else:
            wrapped_values = arr[window_start:window_end]
            
        # Calculate the mean
        smoothed[i] = np.nanmean(wrapped_values)
    
    return smoothed
